$comment: Verdict design tokens. The product UI is dark-first (the Globe direction). The light palette is used for printed exam papers, PDFs and the optional light theme. Tailwind and CSS variables are generated from this file (spec 000).

usage.paper: Page background, like a clean exam sheet. The default ground for every screen.
usage.mist: Quiet surfaces: cards, the study-session canvas, input fills. Depth comes from paper against mist, not shadows.
usage.line: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only; not for control borders.
usage.line-strong: Control borders and unfilled readiness dots. 3.39:1 on paper (light), 4.31:1 (dark): meets the 3:1 rule for controls.
usage.ink: Primary text, the logo, icons. 16.75:1 on paper (light), 16.14:1 (dark).
usage.ink-muted: Secondary text, captions, helper text. 7.03:1 on paper, 6.24:1 on mist (light); 8.81:1 on paper (dark).
usage.verdigris: The brand accent and the meaning 'ready': the logo's full stop, primary buttons, ready topics, links. 4.86:1 on paper (light). On mist (light) it is 4.32:1: use it there only for graphics and text 24px or larger.
usage.on-verdigris: Text and icons on verdigris fills such as primary buttons. 4.86:1 (light), 8.31:1 (dark).
usage.verdigris-soft: Tinted background for ready states and success messages; ink text on it is 14.61:1 (light).
usage.amber: 'Partly ready' graphics: half-filled readiness dots, progress. 3.64:1 on paper (light): graphics only, never body text.
usage.amber-text: 'Partly ready' text and labels. 5.51:1 on paper (light), 8.61:1 (dark).
usage.coral: 'Not yet' and errors: empty readiness states, wrong answers, destructive actions. 5.11:1 on paper (light), 6.67:1 (dark). Always paired with an icon and a word.
usage.focus: Keyboard focus ring: 2px outline with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

background.nebula: radial-gradient(32% 26% at 22% 28%, rgba(60,196,162,.13), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(30% 24% at 78% 66%, rgba(88,118,255,.12), transparent 70%)
